ops.name: Surveillance
ops.flavor: Watch a target closely. Sharpens acquisition diligence or maps a rival pipeline.

ops.name: Steal Tech / Infiltrate
ops.flavor: Pull a rival tech into your tree without doing the science yourself.

ops.name: Sabotage
ops.flavor: Slow a rival's research and market gain for several days.

ops.name: Counter-Intel
ops.flavor: Tighten cover, burn risk. The quiet op that makes the loud ones possible.

ops.name: Expose / Leak
ops.flavor: Ruin a rival's reputation. High effect toward Domination; high heat on you.
